meta.title: Improve indexing and sharing performance
meta.body_summary: Refactor ReportService and DatasetService to use indexed lookups instead of O(n^2) scans, batch DOM updates in JS shares loading, and cache Context Chat availability lookup, with CHANGELOG updates.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI_Codex authored O(n^2) to indexed loop refactor, DOM batching, and cache lookup; self-merged quickly with no review or benchmark evidence.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 161 changed lines across 4 files, this is a small-to-medium sized refactor by absolute volume. It fits a small-step performance PR that was self-merged by the author without review.

review_details.concern_detail: No review or comments present; PR was self-merged by author.
review_details.performance_claim: Reduce O(n^2) scans, batch DOM updates, cache lookup for improved indexing and sharing performance.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Multi-file refactor across PHP services and JavaScript, including time complexity reduction and DOM batching; agent's changes were accepted without review, indicating no technical stack boundary for this small change.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmarks, profiling, or before/after metrics; only narrative claim of O(n^2) improvement and DOM batching.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No regressions reported; second commit 'fixes' adjusts CHANGELOG only.

core_change_summary.description: In DatasetService.php and ReportService.php, replaced O(n^2) nested loops with indexed lookups using associative arrays; in js/app.js, batched DOM fragment appends for share items; added cache for Context Chat availability in DatasetService; updated CHANGELOG.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: CHANGELOG.md has some additions and a later fix commit adjusting its content.
